verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents an n8n REST API page, a CLI, and in-workflow JavaScript/Python code nodes. None of these is an official SDK (a client library) for building against n8n, and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404 on every candidate path. Official SDKs are a fair axis for a workflow-automation platform, so the missing evidence makes this "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
